# trustor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:trustor`](gmeow-trustor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/trustor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent whose (subjective) trust a trust-assertion expresses — the perspective holder.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:trustor`](gmeow-trustor.md) from [`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent FROM WHOSE standpoint a trust assertion is held — the frame holder whose subjective trust the relator expresses (the trust-side counterpart of [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the trusted party (that is [`gmeow:trustee`](gmeow-trustee.md)) and avoid treating the trustor as authoritative for anyone else; every trustor is one co-equal standpoint ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), so competing trustors' assertions coexist. It is functional — one perspective holder per assertion.

### How to use

- Bind exactly one [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) as the trustor; model a second agent's trust in the same trustee as a separate [`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md), never a second trustor on this one.
